Cache hit with OpenDAL memory backend returns cached response on repeat request

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
result = LiterLlm.chat(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Hello', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'openai/gpt-4o'))
puts result.cache_hit.inspect
```
